hero.title: Taxi duty ki fresh leads, ek hi live feed mein
hero.subtitle: EaseCab sainkdon WhatsApp groups ki ride leads ko ek saaf, real-time feed mein laata hai. City se filter karo, poster ko seedha call karo, duty book karo.

features.title: Drivers ke liye bana hai, passengers ke liye nahi

live.title: Live feed
live.body: Nayi lead aate hi dikhti hai — 50 WhatsApp group scroll karne ki zaroorat nahi.

city.title: Sirf aapke cities
city.body: Pickup city se filter karo taaki wahi duty dikhe jo aap le sakte ho.

direct.title: Seedha contact
direct.body: Ek tap mein poster ko call ya WhatsApp karo. Na koi bichauliya, na commission.

post.title: Apni duty post karo
post.body: Duty deni hai? Ek baar post karo aur hazaaron drivers tak turant pahuncho.

languages.title: Aapki bhasha bolta hai
languages.body: EaseCab ko English, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, हिन्दी ya Hinglish mein use karo — kabhi bhi switch karo.

ios.title: iPhone pe ho? EaseCab ko home screen pe add karo
ios.step3: "Add to Home Screen" pe tap karo

footer.tagline: North India ke drivers aur vendors ke liye taxi ride leads.
